Max is reading a book about history. Max drinks juice after doing sports. Max hopes to visit Sydney one day. Best of all, cows give us milk.
The weather was windy that day. Max learned a lot about history. Both of them like soup and juice. What's more, my family lives in Beijing.

It takes twenty minutes to get to the book store by bike. There are always many people at the shopping mall. The book store is one of the best places in the city. Delivery is free for orders over fifty yuan.
